title: The product of two groups is a categorical product in CatS.grp, and it costs no congruence bookkeeping
statement: For any two AlgS.Groups G and H, CatS.grpProd G H is an AlgS.Group whose carrier is Sigma.{0,0} G.carrier (fun _ => H.carrier), whose equiv is the conjunction of the two component equivs, and whose op, e and inv are componentwise; CatS.grpProdFst G H and CatS.grpProdSnd G H are the two Subtype-bundled projections; CatS.grpProdMed G H X u v is the bundled pairing; and CatS.grp_isProduct proves CatS.IsProductLarge CatS.grp G H (CatS.grpProd G H) with those three as its projections and mediating family. The setoid price is measured and is the lowest in this layer: all TEN law fields of the product object are literally And.intro (G.law ...) (H.law ...) with no congruence bookkeeping at all, because the product setoid's equiv IS the conjunction of the two component equivs; and BOTH triangles of grp_isProduct are equivRefl, free because pr1 . (pairing f g) unfolds to fun x => Sigma.fst (Sigma.mk (f x) (g x)) and Sigma.fst ι-reduces on a Sigma.mk. Uniqueness is one And.intro for the same reason.

formal.statement: theorem CatS.grp_isProduct : ((x0 : AlgS.Group) -> ((x1 : AlgS.Group) -> CatS.IsProductLarge CatS.grp x0 x1 (CatS.grpProd x0 x1) (CatS.grpProdFst x0 x1) (CatS.grpProdSnd x0 x1) (CatS.grpProdMed x0 x1)))

evidence.supports: CatS.grpProd, CatS.grpProdFst, CatS.grpProdSnd, CatS.grpProdMed and CatS.grp_isProduct admit through the trusted Kernel::add_declaration gate with an empty Kernel::axiom_footprint, asserted after Environment::contains; grp_isProduct is read back from the environment as a Declaration::Theorem. Every Definition carries an evaluation test at CONCRETE, discriminating, SMALL arguments: two groups on a Nat carrier whose equiv is the total relation (so every law field is True.intro and the operations are free to differ) with op a b = a / op a b = b, e = 0 / e = 1, and inv a = a / inv a = a+1. Measured: op (1,2) (3,4) IS (1,4) and is NOT (3,2), (1,2), (3,4) or (4,1); e IS (0,1) and is NOT (1,0); inv (1,2) IS (1,3) and is NOT (2,2), (1,2) or (3,1); grpProdFst applied to (1,2) IS 1 and is NOT 2, and grpProdSnd IS 2 and is NOT 1. Symbolically: the mediating map's underlying function at x IS (u x, v x) and is NOT a pairing that drops v; each triangle's composite ι-reduces to its OWN component morphism and NOT to the other's; and the product's equiv IS the conjunction of the two component equivs and is NOT the first conjunct alone.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release category_setoid -- --test-threads=4 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 41 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned count is 41, RECOUNTED from the suite's own output. The tests that carry this fact are products_tests::the_product_group_computes_componentwise, products_tests::the_projections_read_their_own_component, products_tests::the_mediating_map_is_the_pairing, products_tests::the_group_products_triangles_are_free_by_iota and products_tests::the_group_products_uniqueness_conjunct_is_pointwise. The two chaotic groups exist so that a component SWAP type-checks at all: with two distinct symbolic groups the kernel's dependent typing refuses a swap outright, so the concrete fixture is the only place a swap can be observed rather than rejected.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel nat_prelude::category_setoid::products, lane cat-products, ADR-1632 (roadmap W3-4).

notes: Which half of the ADR-1613 family the carrier needs is decided by LEVELS, exactly as ADR-1626 found for hom-families: both carriers are Sort 1 = Type 0, so Sigma.{0,0} lands back at Type 0 = Sort 1, which is what AlgS.Group.carrier demands. PSigma.{1,1} also fits; Sigma is chosen because it is the half carrying fst_mk, snd_mk and mk_eta. The ι-reduction that makes the triangles free is the same mechanism ADR-1626 measured for Subtype.val (Subtype.mk f h) at idL, idR and assoc -- the third independent site at which computed-not-extracted pays in BUILD COST rather than only in soundness. There is no Eq-flavoured counterfactual: over Eq the object would be the same but CatS.grp would not exist at all, since the hom-setoid would need funext.
